features: MORE POWERFUL THAN EVER: The EZAD-tv digital signage hardware delivers 4K content and boasts an extensive video gallery with over 250,000 options for a superior viewing experience.

ENJOY OUR FREE PLAN: Enjoy EZ-AD TV with our FREE plan or unlock full features with our premium plans. The free plan supports all image and video formats, includes tech support, and lets you add up to 50 slides per EZ-AD TV box. Upgrade or downgrade whenever you need, according to your preferences.

EFFORTLESS CONTENT CREATION & MANAGEMENT: With our Template Builder, Video Studio, and YouTube Loader, create content effortlessly. Our Mobile App, allows you to manage and generate content on the move, ensuring a seamless content creation experience.
MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Equipped with 1 HDMI port, an Ethernet port, 2 USB type A ports, and a memory card reader, it caters to a variety of usage needs.
FLEXIBLE SCREEN LAYOUTS: Customize your screen layout with vertical display settings on the EZ-AD screen. Divide your screen into various slideshows with videos on top and images in the middle.
AUTO CONTENT UPDATES: Plug our EZ-AD media player into any HD Television and start showcasing product advertisements & videos instantly. Content updates wirelessly from our cloud-based website.
description: Introducing the EZAD-tv digital signage hardware, more powerful than ever before. This state-of-the-art device delivers 4K content, providing a superior viewing experience with an extensive video gallery boasting over 250,000 options. But the power doesn't stop at viewing; it extends to connectivity as well. The device is equipped with multiple connectivity options, including 1 HDMI port, an Ethernet port, 3 USB type A ports, and a memory card reader, catering to a wide range of usage needs. Enjoy our FREE plan that supports all image and video formats, including PNG, JPG, GIF, MP4, AVI and MOV. With our Template Builder, Video Studio, and YouTube Loader, you can create content effortlessly. Our Mobile App (available for iOS and Android) further enhances this experience, allowing you to manage and generate content on the move for a seamless content creation experience. The EZAD-tv digital signage hardware also offers flexible screen layouts. Customize your screen layout with vertical display settings on the EZ-AD screen, dividing your screen into various slideshows with videos on top and images in the middle.
